map.：水(4 画)：竖钩 → 横撇 → 撇 → 捺(中间竖钩先，再左横撇、右撇、收捺: : shui (4 strokes): vertical hook → horizontal-left-falling → left-falling → right-falling (the central vertical hook first, then the left horizontal-falling, the right-falling, and finally the closing right-falling). The common mistake is putting the left-falling stroke first.
map.：火(4 画)：点 → 短撇 → 长撇 → 捺(先两点、再人字撇捺)。「先两边后: : huo (4 strokes): dot → short left-falling → long left-falling → right-falling (the two dots first, then the two falling strokes that form the ren shape). The rule "both sides before the middle" applies to characters like huo and xiao.
